jobs.title: Principal Consultant / Technical Director - Ecotoxicology & Ecological Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
Principal Consultant / Technical Director – Ecotoxicology & Ecological Risk Assessment

Lead Technical Excellence. Shape Strategy. Grow a Market-Leading Practice.

Are you an established Ecotoxicologist or Ecological Risk Assessor
looking for an opportunity to build your profile, influence major projects, and help shape the future direction of a growing environmental consultancy practice?

We are seeking an experienced Principal Consultant or Technical Director
to join and lead our Ecotoxicology and Ecological Risk Assessment group as part of the Toxicology & Risk team
. This is a key technical and business role for a recognised industry professional with a strong technical reputation, established client relationships, and a passion for growing business and developing people.

As a key member within our Soils, Geochemistry, Toxicology and Risk Practice
, you will work alongside a highly regarded team of specialist consultants, including a dedicated ecotoxicology group and a broader multidisciplinary practice of more than 40+ experts across Asia Pacific.

This is more than a technical leadership role. It is an opportunity to join a collaborative team that combines deep technical expertise with a strong growth mindset. You will have the autonomy to shape the direction of the ecotoxicology practice while being supported by a substantial multidisciplinary network of specialists who are solving some of the most complex environmental challenges across the region.

We have just over 1,200 staff in Asia Pacific and you will find us located in all the major cities and many regional areas. We are open to location for the successful person where we have established offices in place.

Responsibilities

Working with other technical specialists who are passionate about their fields and highly collaborative employees, this role offers the platform to:

Lead and grow a successful ecotoxicology and ecological risk assessment capability.
Drive business development and work-winning initiatives across existing and emerging markets.
Leverage your professional network and industry profile to identify opportunities and develop long-term client partnerships.
Provide technical leadership on complex environmental, contaminated land, mining, industrial, infrastructure and regulatory projects.
Mentor and develop a team of talented ecotoxicologists and risk assessment specialists.
Collaborate with leading experts across contaminated land, geochemistry, toxicology, human health risk assessment, hydrogeology and environmental sciences.
Influence strategic direction, service offerings and market growth within a well-established environmental consulting business.

Experience

Not only will you be a honest, trusted and great person to be around, you will also be a recognised technical leader who brings:

Relevant tertiary qualifications in ecotoxicology, environmental science, ecology, toxicology or a related discipline coupled with 10-15+ years’ experience (ideally within a consulting environment but open to other industry)
A strong reputation within industry, regulatory, government and/or commercial sectors.
Demonstrated success in winning work, developing client relationships and generating revenue growth.
Established networks and connections that can contribute to the continued expansion of the practice.
Experience leading multidisciplinary project teams and mentoring technical professionals.
Strong commercial acumen and the ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Our Benefits

We are most proud of our expert teams and unique culture where we work together to collaborate on projects to get the best possible outcome for our clients.

Whether you’re enjoying our flexible hybrid work environment, taking advantage of our novated leasing offers, or at a time in your life where a supportive and generous parental leave scheme is key, our benefits aim to ensure that we cater for all.

You can find a comprehensive list here.

Next Steps

If leading an established and premier team at a global multidisciplinary consultancy is your next career move, apply now with a copy of your CV and cover letter.

Unsolicited resumes from recruitment consultants will not be accepted. You must be part of the preferred supplier agreement list which is coordinated through our Talent Acquisition team.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist – Contaminated Land
jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Come grow with us.

AECOM's environmental practice is dedicated to helping industries, clients and governments meet their environmental responsibilities while protecting the natural environment. We provide advisory and technical services to ensure compliance, manage impacts, and reduce risks, including obtaining permits and approvals, decommissioning and restoring contaminated sites, and tackling climate change challenges and resilience. We focus on preserving habitats, water quality, stakeholder engagement and cultural resources, promoting a holistic approach to environmental impact management at every project stage.

Our highly regarded Environmental team in Melbourne is seeking Professional Environmental Scientist/ Engineer with experience with Contaminated land investigations and remediation to support a range of exciting and meaningful projects across the energy, resources, Infrastructure and defence sectors.

What will a day in this role look like:

Delivering fieldwork across ground remediation and contaminated land projects, including site investigations, remediation works, validation sampling and monitoring across the Victoria
Managing field projects, including supervising contractors and mentoring graduates onsite
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality, client-focused outcomes
Engaging with clients, regulators, and stakeholders to support project delivery
Contributing to a positive team culture and collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment

Qualifications

The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes, you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

What are we looking for from you?

A degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field, and a valid Australian driver’s licence
Willingness to undertake regular fieldwork across contaminated land and remediation projects, including site investigations, remediation works and monitoring programs
Around 2- 5 years experience in ground remediation, including contaminated land assessment, soil and groundwater remediation or related field-based work ideally
Able to work independently, manage competing priorities and get involved across a wide range of projects while contributing to a supportive, team-focused environment
Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – with the ability to translate technical concepts clearly
A collaborative mindset and the ability to work independently when needed
A proactive attitude, curiosity to learn, and a commitment to delivering quality work

Additional Information

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, additional health or mental health needs, and/or neurodiverse conditions. If you require any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

Applications are reviewed as they come in, and the role may close earlier than expected, so if this opportunity sounds like you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Learn more about life at AECOM: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, X, YouTube - explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

We pay our respects to their cultures and to their Elders — past, present, and emerging. We are committed to connecting to Country in our work through meaningful engagement with First Nations peoples and businesses. Find out more about our Australian Reconciliation Action Plan here: https://aecom.com/au/our-vision-for-reconciliation/.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation and benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We also provide a robust global well-being program. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.
